title: Personal code relay open circuit or short circuit
detail_of_failure: The machine monitor senses an open circuit or a ground fault in the circuit of the personal code relay.
controller_action: • None in particular. (When an open circuit occurs) • Stops to drive the personal code relay. (When a ground fault occurs) • If the cause of the failure disappears, the machine becomes normal by itself. (When an open circuit occurs) • After the cause of the failure is removed, the machine does not become normal until the starting switch is turned to the OFF position once. (When a ground fault occurs)
machine_effect: • The start motor operates even after the engine starts. (When an open circuit occurs) • The starting motor does not operate. (When a ground fault occurs)
related_information: Notice While this failure code is shown, if you turn the key switch to the START position after the engine has started, the pinion of starting motor may break. Reference information This failure code is shown only when the engine lock function is enabled.

steps.procedure: 1. Check the wiring harnesses and connectors. REMARK For details of checking method, see “RELATED INFORMATION TO TROUBLESHOOT”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”. 2. Are the wiring harnesses and connectors normal?

branches.YES: • The wiring harnesses and connectors are normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • A wiring harness or connector is defective. • Repair or replace the defective wiring harness or connector. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Turn the starting switch to the OFF position. 2. Check that the system operating lamp is turned off. Turn the battery disconnect switch to the OFF position. 3. Remove fuse No.3 in fuse box F01. 4. Check if the fuse is blown. 5. Check the fuse for continuity. 6. Is the fuse normal?

branches.YES: • Fuse No.3 is normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • FuseNo.3 is defective. • It blown, go to “Ground fault in wiring harness”. • If fuse No.3 is not blown but has no continuity, replace it. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.
